basic_details.scholarship_name: Swedish Institute Scholarship for Global Professionals (SISGP)
basic_details.offering_entity: Swedish Institute (SI - Ministry for Foreign Affairs of Sweden)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Participating Swedish Universities (KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Chalmers University of Technology, Lund University, Uppsala University, Linköping University, Stockholm University)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Master's programmes contributing to the UN 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development (Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, AI, Renewable Energy, Environmental Engineering, Public Health).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~300 to 350 prestigious scholarships awarded globally per academic year
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Country quota for Pakistan (~20 to 35 scholarships awarded annually to Pakistani professionals)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 24 months (1 to 2-year full-time master's degree programs)

nationality_requirements: Citizens of 41 eligible DAC countries including Pakistan
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age limit under Swedish Institute regulations.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16-year BS / BSc / BE) from an HEC-recognized university with strong academic performance (minimum CGPA 3.40 / 4.00 or 78%+).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.40 / 4.00; competitive applicants typically hold CGPA >= 3.60 / 4.00.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Degree relevant to chosen master's programme with verified admission offer via UniversityAdmissions.se.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Must hold an undergraduate degree and demonstrate verified professional work experience.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: No restriction on year of graduation.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Mandatory requirement of at least 3,000 hours of demonstrated work experience (equivalent to approximately 1.5 to 2 years of full-time employment) and demonstrated leadership experience.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic overall minimum 6.5 (no section below 5.5) or TOEFL iBT minimum 90 (writing at least 20). MOI certificates are not accepted by Swedish university admissions for non-exempt countries.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Swedish language proficiency is not required; all eligible master's programmes are taught in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants must demonstrate leadership experience and clear commitment to contributing to UN Sustainable Development Goals.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Ineligible if previously awarded a Swedish Institute scholarship for master's or PhD, or holds a degree from a Swedish university.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee paid directly by the Swedish Institute to the host Swedish university (worth SEK 160,000 to SEK 310,000).
tuition_fee.amount: 100% Full Tuition Fee Paid Directly (~SEK 300,000 value)

admission_application_fee.details: Application fee of SEK 900 (~PKR 24,000) payable to UniversityAdmissions.se during Swedish national university application.

accommodation.details: Funded directly from the monthly living allowance; Swedish universities provide guaranteed or prioritized housing for SI scholars.

monthly_stipend.details: SEK 12,000 / month tax-free living allowance throughout the entire study period (~PKR 315,000 / month).

airfare.details: SEK 15,000 one-time travel grant paid upon arrival in Sweden to cover international travel costs.

visa_fee.details: Swedish Residence Permit for higher education application fee (~SEK 1,500) paid to Swedish Migration Agency (Migrationsverket).

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive Swedish State Insurance for foreign students (Student IN) covering illness, accident, and liability in Sweden.

food_allowance.details: Covered via monthly SEK 12,000 living stipend plus access to student kitchen facilities and campus cafeterias.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to university library systems and digital journal repositories across Swedish universities.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Exclusive membership in the SI Network for Future Global Leaders (NFGL) with sponsored leadership workshops and study visits.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Subsidized regional student transit cards across Stockholm (SL), Gothenburg (Västtrafik), and Skåne (Skånetrafiken).

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Multiple host institutions across Sweden (KTH, Chalmers, Lund, Uppsala, Linköping, Stockholm University).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: World top 100-150 universities renowned for technology, engineering, sustainability, and human-computer interaction.
available_majors: MSc in Computer Science & Software Engineering
MSc in Machine Learning & Data Science
MSc in Cybersecurity and Information Security
MSc in Sustainable Energy & Electrical Engineering
MSc in Environmental Management and Policy
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor degree in relevant field, IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 90+, 3,000+ hours documented work experience, proof of leadership, two recommendation letters on official SI templates.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Two-step process: apply for up to 4 master's programmes at UniversityAdmissions.se by January 15, then apply for the SI Scholarship in February.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Check the SI Eligible Master's Programme list carefully; only apply to master's programs explicitly listed by the Swedish Institute.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Swedish Institute Application Portal & University Admissions Sweden
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Step 1: Apply for master's programs at UniversityAdmissions.se (deadline mid-January). Step 2: Receive 8-digit application number. Step 3: Apply for SI Scholarship on the SI portal in February using mandatory SI templates.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Research eligible master's programmes on the official Swedish Institute website and select up to 4 programmes.
Step 2: Submit master's applications via UniversityAdmissions.se between October 15 and January 15 and pay SEK 900 fee.
Step 3: Upload academic transcripts, degree certificates, and IELTS/TOEFL scorecard to UniversityAdmissions.se before the document deadline (February 1).
Step 4: Prepare mandatory SI application templates: SI CV, Proof of Work and Leadership Experience, and two Letters of Reference.
Step 5: Apply on the Swedish Institute scholarship portal between February 10 and February 28, inputting your 8-digit University Admissions application number.
Step 6: University admissions results announced at UniversityAdmissions.se in late March; candidate must receive an admission offer to remain eligible.
Step 7: Swedish Institute announces scholarship recipients in late April.
Step 8: Accept scholarship offer and apply for Swedish Residence Permit for Studies.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Separate Routing: Candidates must first apply for university admission via national portal UniversityAdmissions.se, then apply separately to the Swedish Institute.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted using mandatory SI Letter of Reference templates, signed and stamped by referees, and uploaded to the SI portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Structured motivation questionnaire detailing how study in Sweden connects to professional background, leadership vision, and UN SDGs in Pakistan.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Integrated within the university application and SI motivation essay questions.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Mandatory Swedish Institute CV template (strict max 3 pages; applications using any other CV format are disqualified).
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interviews; selection is based entirely on written application materials, leadership proof, and academic dossier.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.5+ (min 5.5 each) or TOEFL iBT 90+ (min 20 writing).
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: SEK 900 (university application fee; SI scholarship application is free)
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC and university attested documents uploaded to UniversityAdmissions.se.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official English translation for all documents not issued in English.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via Swedish Institute scholarship portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Must strictly use the official SI CV template without altering headers or exceeding length limits.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Proof of Work and Leadership Experience Form
required_documents_checklist.specification: Completed official SI proof form documenting at least 3,000 hours of professional work and leadership roles, signed and stamped by employers.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Two Letters of Reference on SI Templates
required_documents_checklist.specification: Two recommendation letters using official SI templates (at least one must be from a work supervisor).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Signed and stamped on official letterhead.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Color copy of valid Pakistani passport identification page.
Completed answers to SI portal essay prompts explaining leadership potential and sustainable development impact in Pakistan.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Connect explicitly to UN SDGs and Pakistan's development.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: University admissions window closes January 15; SI scholarship application window is open from February 10 to February 28.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 30% (Academic performance and admission ranking at UniversityAdmissions.se)
selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 25% (Demonstrated leadership track record in profession and civil society)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 10% (Technical depth and competence in chosen field)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 25% (Verified 3,000+ hours work experience and quality of professional achievements)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of vision on contributing to UN Sustainable Development Goals)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Swedish Institute Evaluation Committee comprising independent assessors and leadership experts.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-stage evaluation: formal eligibility and template check, followed by expert scoring of leadership potential and SDG contribution.

competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~4% to 6% among qualified professionals meeting the 3,000 hours work threshold
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 3.60 / 4.00 accompanied by 3+ years of professional leadership experience
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Mid-career software engineers, cybersecurity specialists, sustainability managers, or public policy leaders with documented impact.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Professionals from leading Pakistani tech firms, multinational corporations, research organizations, and NGOs.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, South Africa, Indonesia, Bangladesh, Brazil.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply via the official Swedish Institute website https://si.se/ and UniversityAdmissions.se.
Never pay any agency or third party claiming to guarantee an SI scholarship.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: SI scholarship application is completely free; only UniversityAdmissions.se charges standard SEK 900 application fee.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Swedish Institute explicitly disqualifies applications submitted or prepared by commercial agencies; all templates must be authentic.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Swedish residence permit application fee: SEK 1,500 (~PKR 40,000).
Initial expenses before travel grant disbursement: ~SEK 2,000.
HEC degree attestation fees in Pakistan: ~PKR 15,000 to 20,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You can use your own custom CV format. Reality: Applications that do not use the official SI CV template are disqualified automatically without review.
Myth: Fresh graduates with internships qualify for the work requirement. Reality: 3,000 hours of documented professional employment is strictly mandatory.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial consultants claim any master's degree in Sweden is covered; SI publishes a specific list of eligible programmes, and non-listed programmes are strictly ineligible.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic progression and pass courses according to host university guidelines.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Mandatory full-time study; scholars must attend NFGL events and annual network meetings.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Host universities submit credit completion reports to the Swedish Institute at the end of each academic term.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Part-time work permitted under Swedish student residence permit, but SI fellowship requires full-time academic commitment.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; zero service bond or mandatory return requirement.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Revocation of scholarship if student abandons studies, provides false documentation, or fails academic progression.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Non-transferable to other universities or degree programmes.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing degree program is strictly prohibited under the scholarship agreement.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship cannot be extended beyond the official duration of the master's program (maximum 24 months).
